prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='CWT_rf', seasonality_champion='CWT_rf', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: CWT_rf dominates both trend (1.0 correlation) and seasonality (0.5874 correlation) tracking, making it the pattern champion. However, ONLY_DWT_catboost achieves the lowest overall RMSE (531.79) despite slightly lower seasonal correlation. With rankings unstable (Kendall τ=0.193) and high model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio=21.17), robust median/trimmed-mean combinations are preferred over stacking to avoid overfitting noise.
